title: Call Centre Operator
description:
Shift Pattern - 20 hours - Evenings
Location - Glasgow
Start date - 12.10.2026
Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE. Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.Our Glasgow team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.
What does being a sales advisor involve?You'll join a lively sales team in our Glasgow contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.
Forget what you've heard about salesDon't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?
Why you'll be better off at EE
GREAT MONEY - you start on £13,928.53 which goes up to £14,260.27 after 8 months.
UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, discounted parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Digital Helpdesk Support Apprentice
description:
DS Business Solutions is a leading provider of managed print services, document solutions, and IT support services. We work with organisations across a range of sectors, helping them improve productivity through innovative technology solutions, expert support, and outstanding customer service.

Our team supports customers with multifunctional devices (MFDs), business software, digital systems, and technical services. We pride ourselves on building long-term relationships with our customers, providing reliable support and tailored solutions to meet their needs.

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated apprentice to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to develop a career in IT and customer support while working towards a nationally recognised Digital Applications Support qualification.

About the role:

You will act as the first point of contact for customers requiring technical assistance and support. You will help users resolve a variety of digital and technology-related issues whilst developing valuable skills in troubleshooting, customer service, digital systems, and IT support.

Working alongside experienced colleagues, you will gain hands-on experience supporting customers both remotely and on-site, building technical knowledge across a range of systems, software applications, and business technologies.

Responsibilities:
- Act as the first point of contact for customer technical support enquiries via telephone, email, and digital support systems
- Log, monitor, update, and manage support tickets using the company's service management platform
- Develop expertise in DS Business Solutions' key business systems, including MPS Estate Management System, IT Database, Select Billing System, Service Logging System, Konica Minolta software applications and customer support tools
- Support customers with printing, scanning, networking, software, and connectivity issues
- Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, resolving first-line support requests wherever possible
- Escalate more complex technical issues to senior engineers and specialist support teams when required
- Assist with the installation, configuration, and maintenance of multifunctional devices (MFDs) and associated software solutions
- Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, support requests, resolutions, and technical updates
- Use digital tools and systems to monitor workloads, prioritise support requests, and track service delivery
- Produce reports and update system records to ensure data accuracy and service quality
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring issues and suggesting improvements to systems and processes

Required skills:
- A full, clean UK driving licence is required due to the field-based nature of the role
- Willingness to travel to customer sites as required
- A genuine interest in technology, IT support, and digital systems
- Strong communication and customer service skills
- Eagerness to learn and develop new technical skills

Working hours: 8.30am - 5.30pm, Monday to Friday

What we offer:

We are committed to developing talent and helping our people build rewarding careers. You'll be joining a supportive team where you can learn from experienced professionals, gain industry-recognised qualifications, and play an important role in delivering exceptional service to our customers.
- Company vehicle provided for business use
- Laptop, tablet, and mobile phone supplied
- Full training on Konica Minolta devices, software, and managed print technologies
- Support towards completing a Digital Helpdesk Support SCQF Level 6 apprenticeship
- Ongoing mentoring and development from experienced engineers and technical specialists
- Quarterly performance bonus scheme
- Opportunity to gain hands-on experience across IT support, customer service, digital systems, and managed print solutions
- Clear career progression opportunities within a growing technology business

Future prospects:

90% of QA apprentices secure permanent employment after completing: this is 20% higher than the national average.

Important information:

This vocational apprenticeship comprehensively supports your specific job role with this particular employer. Throughout your learning journey, you are fully supported by your dedicated QA skills coach and your mentor at work. They ensure you settle in, help you develop all the skills you need to be successful in your job role and pass your assessments, and can provide one to one support.

Starting with insights into your current potential, they plan your growth in a programmatic way, close skills gaps with immersive training and ensure what you learn is applicable to what you do. They talk you through the specifics on the qualifications you gain and how they align in particular to your day to day role.

On completion, as well as the valuable work experience you have gained, you get a nationally recognised qualification at SCQF Level 6.

If you are interested in starting your career and receiving a work based qualification at the same time APPLY NOW!
